import pathlib, subprocess

D = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
CASES = {
    'ord_undefined':      '<?php var_dump(ord($undeclared));',
    'eval_barrier':       "<?php echo $created; eval('$created = 1;'); echo $created;",
    'enum_method':        '<?php enum E { case A; public function f(): int { return $missing; } } var_dump(E::A->f());',
    'list_unpack_null':   '<?php [$a, $b] = $missing; var_dump($a, $b);',
    'list_unpack_scalar': '<?php [$a, $b] = 42; var_dump($a, $b);',
    'spread_then_undef':  '<?php $x = 5; $s = [...$x]; echo count($s); echo $undefined_for_real;',
    'method_scope':       '<?php $value = 5; class C { public function f(): int { return $value; } } var_dump((new C)->f());',
    'two_missing':        '<?php echo $missing; echo $also_missing;',
    'prop_on_null':       '<?php $o = null; var_dump($o->name);',
    'offset_on_null':     '<?php $o = null; var_dump($o[0]);',
    'strlen_undef':       '<?php $x = $undef; var_dump(strlen($x));',
    'undef_plus_int':     '<?php var_dump($u + 1);',
}
for name, src in CASES.items():
    f = D / (name + '.php')
    f.write_text(src + '\n')
    r = subprocess.run(['php', '-n', str(f)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print('=== ' + name + ' === rc=' + str(r.returncode))
    print('--- stdout ---')
    print(r.stdout, end='')
    if r.stderr:
        print('--- stderr ---')
        print(r.stderr, end='')
    print()
